elo_diff.definition: Elo rating before the target game
elo_diff.point_in_time_rule: all game outcomes are strictly prior; no target-game box score or future aggregate is admitted
elo_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN when unavailable; train-fold median imputation for linear members and native NaN for tree members
